# Tini Time Club

> Find your next great Martini. Tini Time Club is an iPhone and Android app for discovering nearby bars, comparing Martini reviews, and saving favorite spots.

This file points agents and language models to the public pages that explain Tini Time Club, its publisher, support resources, and legal policies. The canonical website is https://tinitimeclub.com.

## Public Pages

- [Tini Time Club homepage](https://tinitimeclub.com/): Product overview for the Martini discovery app, including core features and the iOS and Android download links.
- [About Hope Media House](https://tinitimeclub.com/about): Publisher information, editorial responsibility, and contact context for Tini Time Club.
- [For bars and restaurants](https://tinitimeclub.com/business): How venues get in touch with the Tini Time Club team.
- [Support](https://tinitimeclub.com/support): App support, account help, feature answers, reporting guidance, and accessibility contact information.
- [Privacy Policy](https://tinitimeclub.com/privacy): How Hope Media House Inc. collects, uses, shares, and protects information for Tini Time Club.
- [Terms of Service](https://tinitimeclub.com/terms): Terms, community guidelines, user content rules, and legal conditions for using Tini Time Club.
